name: certichain-monorepo
description: CertiChain: Blockchain-Based Academic Certificate Verification & Fraud Detection Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run node:chain" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --workspace=blockchain run compile && npm --workspace=backend run build && npm --workspace=frontend run build
